hero.title: Document translation, legalization and certified copies, all in one place
hero.text: We translate official, academic and legal documents (Thai–English) and handle legalization filings at the Department of Consular Affairs. Based in Hua Hin, serving clients nationwide, with delivery by EMS.

services.title: Our services
services.lead: Use them separately or together, whatever your documents need.

items.title: Certified copies of records
items.text: We obtain copies at the district office on your behalf, such as birth and death certificates, house registration, name-change records, marriage/divorce registrations, certificates of single status and parental authority certificates (Por.Kor.14).

items.title: Document translation
items.text: General documents 300 THB/page, legal documents 500 THB/page. We check names, numbers and dates against the original, and you review the draft before we prepare the final version.

items.title: Legalization filing (document certification)
items.text: We check your documents, book the queue and file them at the Department of Consular Affairs on your behalf. It usually takes about 3–4 working days.

items.title: Marriage registration
items.text: Included in the price: express booking for your marriage registration · a locked-in registration date · an interpreter and witnesses arranged for you · on the day, we check the key details on your marriage certificate are correct.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.lead: Tap a question to see the answer

items.q: Can I send photos from my phone?
items.a: Yes, as long as all the text is complete and clear.
By language, document type and number of pages. We always tell you the price before work starts.

items.q: Do my documents need to be certified?
items.a: It depends on the agency and the destination country, so please check with the destination first. If you send us the list of documents, we are happy to take a quick look.

items.q: How do you send documents outside Hua Hin?
items.a: By EMS nationwide, and we send a PDF file as well.

We use the information in your documents only to translate and submit them as you request. We never share it with anyone except the agency the documents are submitted to, and we delete your files and photos within 30 days of delivery.

contact.title: Ready to look at your documents
contact.text: Send a photo of your documents for a price estimate. No consultation fee.

footer.disclaimer: Moonnos acts on behalf of customers and is not a government agency. Requirements differ by country and by agency, so always check with the destination agency.
